title: Signal Protocol Entities
description: Schema defining the core cryptographic entities used in the Signal Protocol, including identity keys, pre-key bundles, signed pre-keys, Kyber post-quantum pre-keys, and session state. These entities form the foundation of the key exchange and message encryption mechanisms used by Signal clients and server.

IdentityKey.title: Identity Key
IdentityKey.description: A long-term Curve25519 identity key pair used to identify an account. Each account has an ACI (Account Identity) key and a PNI (Phone Number Identity) key.

publicKey.description: The Base64-encoded Curve25519 public identity key (32 bytes).

PreKey.title: One-Time Pre-Key
PreKey.description: An ephemeral Curve25519 key pair uploaded to the server for use in the X3DH or PQXDH key agreement. Each pre-key is used at most once.

keyId.description: The unique identifier for this pre-key.

publicKey.description: The Base64-encoded Curve25519 public key (32 bytes).

SignedPreKey.title: Signed Pre-Key
SignedPreKey.description: A medium-term Curve25519 key pair signed by the identity key. Rotated periodically and used as a fallback when one-time pre-keys are exhausted.

keyId.description: The unique identifier for this signed pre-key.

publicKey.description: The Base64-encoded Curve25519 public key (32 bytes).

signature.description: The Base64-encoded XEdDSA signature over the public key, created with the identity private key (64 bytes).

KyberPreKey.title: Kyber Post-Quantum Pre-Key
KyberPreKey.description: A post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism (KEM) key pair using CRYSTALS-Kyber, uploaded to the server for the PQXDH key agreement protocol. Provides quantum resistance for forward secrecy.

keyId.description: The unique identifier for this Kyber pre-key.

signature.description: The Base64-encoded signature over the Kyber public key, created with the identity private key.

PreKeyBundle.title: Pre-Key Bundle
PreKeyBundle.description: A complete pre-key bundle retrieved from the server for establishing a new Signal Protocol session. Contains identity key, signed pre-key, optional one-time pre-key, and optional Kyber pre-key.

identityKey.description: The Base64-encoded identity public key of the account.

registrationId.description: The registration ID of the target device.

deviceId.description: The device identifier. Primary device is always 1.

pqPreKey.description: An optional one-time Kyber post-quantum pre-key for PQXDH.

MessageEnvelope.title: Message Envelope
MessageEnvelope.description: A Signal Protocol message envelope containing encrypted content and routing metadata.

sourceUuid.description: The sender's ACI UUID. Absent in sealed sender messages.

sourceDevice.description: The sender's device ID. Absent in sealed sender messages.

timestamp.description: The client-side send timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

serverTimestamp.description: The server-side receive timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

serverGuid.description: A server-assigned GUID for this delivery instance.

urgent.description: Whether this message should be treated as urgent for push delivery.

story.description: Whether this envelope contains a story message.

Account.title: Signal Account
Account.description: A Signal user account identified by a phone number and one or more UUIDs.

uuid.description: The ACI (Account Identity) UUID, the primary stable identifier.

number.description: The E164-formatted phone number associated with the account.

pni.description: The PNI (Phone Number Identity) UUID, which changes when the phone number changes.

usernameHash.description: The Base64url-encoded SHA-256 hash of the username, if set.

identityKey.description: The Base64-encoded ACI identity public key.

pniIdentityKey.description: The Base64-encoded PNI identity public key.

devices.description: The list of devices linked to this account.

Device.title: Device
Device.description: A device linked to a Signal account. Each account has a primary device (ID 1) and may have additional linked devices.

id.description: The device identifier. The primary device is always 1.

registrationId.description: The Signal Protocol registration ID for this device.

lastSeen.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the device last connected.

created.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the device was linked.

fetchesMessages.description: Whether this device uses WebSocket to fetch messages (true) or relies on push notifications (false).

apnId.description: The Apple Push Notification Service token for iOS devices.

gcmId.description: The Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token for Android devices.

SealedSenderCertificate.title: Sealed Sender Certificate
SealedSenderCertificate.description: A delivery certificate issued by the server for sealed sender message delivery. Sealed sender hides the sender identity from the server during message transmission.

certificate.description: The Base64-encoded signed certificate containing the sender's UUID, device ID, identity key, and expiration.

expiration.description: The certificate expiration timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

GroupV2.title: Signal Group (V2)
GroupV2.description: A Signal group using the V2 groups protocol with server-side state. Groups use zero-knowledge group credentials to maintain member privacy.

groupId.description: The Base64-encoded group identifier derived from the master key.

avatar.description: The CDN path to the encrypted group avatar.

revision.description: The current group state revision number.

members.description: The list of group members with their roles.

accessControl.description: Access control settings for group modifications.

members.description: Who can modify the member list.

addFromInviteLink.description: Who can join via invite link.

GroupMember.title: Group Member
GroupMember.description: A member of a Signal V2 group.

role.description: The member's role in the group.

joinedAtRevision.description: The group revision at which this member joined.
